gauge.name: Neches River near Neches

impacts.statement: Severe flooding with several some secondary roadways flooded. Preparations should be completed for a major flood.
Expect moderate to severe flooding of river bottoms with some camps and access roads flooded.
Minor lowland flooding.  Move livestock and equipment to higher ground away from the river.

Expect minor lowland flooding of the heavily wooded floodplain. Ranchers that may have livestock and equipment in the river bottoms should move them to higher ground.  Expect minor flooding of the boat ramp.

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 24 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
